issues.description: Default v3 speaker mismatch between config and docstrings
issues.detail: Docstrings and PR description state bulbul:v3-beta defaults to 'aditya', but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. This causes a confusing surprise when callers omit voice_id, contradicts documented behavior, and will likely break user expectations.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT connect kwargs
issues.detail: The previous code passed 'input_audio_codec' in connect_kwargs; the refactor removes it entirely. If the Sarvam SDK uses this to interpret non-default codecs (e.g., not wav), audio will be misinterpreted. The constructor still accepts input_audio_codec, making it a silent no-op.

issues.description: Pace clamping warning fires on default value for v3
issues.detail: InputParams.pace defaults to 1.0 with validator ge=0.3/le=3.0. v3-beta pace_range is (0.5, 2.0). Users who never set pace and pick v3 are fine, but any v2-tuned pace like 0.4 silently clamps with a warning rather than raising. Combined with pydantic Field bounds being wider than model capability, validation is inconsistent.

issues.description: Backward-incompatible change: voice_id default changed from 'anushka' to None
issues.detail: Previous signature was voice_id: str = 'anushka'. New signature voice_id: Optional[str] = None changes typing and resolution behavior. Existing callers relying on positional defaults or type annotations may break. Also type hint on parameter is now Optional but downstream assumes str.

issues.description: Warnings compare Optional[float] to literal without None check
issues.detail: Checks like 'elif params.pitch != 0.0' will trigger warning when user explicitly passes pitch=None on v3. Since pitch is Optional[float], None != 0.0 is True, producing a spurious warning for a parameter the user opted out of. Guard with 'is not None and != default'.

issues.description: Speaker not validated against model's allowed speakers
issues.detail: get_speakers_for_model() exists but is never used to validate voice_id in __init__. A user passing a v2 speaker name with v3-beta model will fail at the API layer rather than getting a clear local error. Given enums were added for type safety, validating here would complete the contract.

review.summary: The refactor to config-driven model dispatch is a clean improvement, but several regressions slipped in: input_audio_codec is no longer forwarded to the STT SDK, the v3 default speaker disagrees between code and docs ('shubh' vs documented 'aditya'), and pace bounds in pydantic Field are wider than per-model capabilities, leading to silent clamping. Parameter-ignored warnings fire on None values, and the new voice_id signature is mildly backward-incompatible. Adding speaker validation via get_speakers_for_model would close the loop on the new enum-based type safety.
